notes: Article partition verified: the dative ταῖς anchors *with the* as one unit headed on *the* (rule 21), while both genitive articles are unrepresented, the ASV writing *of men* and *of angels* with no determiner, so the case preposition stays with each noun (rules 21, 23).
The supplied *a* of *a clanging cymbal* stays on the noun and the participle is bare, per rule 58's anarthrous adjective-plus-noun clause, discontinuously under rule 15.
Verb heads stand on the lexical words *speak* and *become* rather than on the supplied subject or the auxiliary (rules 9, 17).
